NewsArticle.Title: King's Hunt
NewsArticle.Content: . The King collects several strange baubles for me, Lady Blanchefleur, Sir Thibault, Librarian Blaise, Councilor Jean, and his own highness, King Bruce. Can you get several before Sweet Danaan, the Sun, fully circles Temuair? I'll be collecting for his highness only during the fair, although I must remain in the court to give his highness good humor. Courtney Loures Court Jester
